text:
marie: FYI Odyssey Labs (acct ODY-1123) flagged 45 days overdue — invoice INV-2024-089. They replied to the dunning saying cashflow is tight and asked to split into 3 monthly payments with 25% upfront. cc @ethan @sara

ethan: thanks — do we have any disputed usage or credits on that account that would change the balance?

sara: is legal fine with offering split payments + waiving late fees? need to know what concessions we can make.

marie: no usage disputes on our side, invoice matches portal. proposal I'd like to try: 25% now, then 37.5% + 37.5% over next two months. keep late fee waived if they stick to schedule and sign a PA (payment agreement).

ethan: that schedule looks ok from collections POV. can we require ACH or corporate card on file? prefer ACH mandate in writing.

omkar: Omkar (Finance) here — thumbs up conditional on signed PA and proof of payment (screenshot or txn id) for the upfront 25%. also request we log the plan in the billing system and set auto-reminders.

jess: Jess (CS) spoke with their CFO, they said ACH is fine but they need an invoice that shows the split. they sent an email acceptance (I can paste screenshot in #customer-docs).

marie: perfect — I'll draft the payment agreement and updated invoice. Draft payment schedule:```
INV-2024-089 total: $48,000
Upfront (25%): $12,000 due within 5 business days of PA
Installment 1 (37.5%): $18,000 due 30 days after upfront payment
Installment 2 (37.5%): $18,000 due 60 days after upfront payment
Late fee: waived if PA signed and payments made on time; otherwise standard terms apply
```

sara: legal ok with that language; include clause that permitting us to resume collections if missed payment and 5-day cure window.

marie: noted — will add cure window. billing-bot: please create invoice revision and attach PA template.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-089 (rev 1) created. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2024-089/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Hold placed on escalation for ODY-1123 while PA is pending (looks like 45 days overdue). Automated reminder scheduled in 7 days.

ethan: once we get the 25% txn id, update the ledger and remove the delinquency flag. please remind CS to upload the ACH mandate.

jess: uploaded email thread + screenshot to #customer-docs and sent ACH mandate form to their CFO. they replied "sign and return" within 24 hours.

omkar: once upfront clears, finance will apply payment and release to good standing. Omkar approving waive of late fees conditional on compliance — leaving final sign-off to @omkar.

marie: thanks all. I'll send PA and revised invoice to Odyssey with a 5-business-day deadline for the upfront. Follow-up if no response by next Wed and we'll escalate. :pray:
